from pysat.solvers import Glucose3
from pysat.card import CardEnc, EncType

n = 17
pairs = [(i,j) for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1,n)]
var_of = {p: i+1 for i,p in enumerate(pairs)}

def encode(num_edges):
    solver = Glucose3()
    # For girth >= 6, forbid all cycles of length 3, 4, 5.
    from itertools import combinations
    # Triangles: for each triple, not all three edges
    for a,b,c in combinations(range(n),3):
        e1 = var_of[(a,b)]; e2 = var_of[(a,c)]; e3 = var_of[(b,c)]
        solver.add_clause([-e1,-e2,-e3])
    # 4-cycles: for each set of 4 vertices, forbid any 4-cycle
    for quad in combinations(range(n),4):
        a,b,c,d = quad
        # three perfect matchings form 4-cycles: (ab,cd)+(ac,bd), etc.
        # cycle a-b-c-d-a uses edges ab,bc,cd,da
        for perm in [(a,b,c,d),(a,b,d,c),(a,c,b,d)]:
            w,x,y,z = perm
            e1 = var_of[(min(w,x),max(w,x))]
            e2 = var_of[(min(x,y),max(x,y))]
            e3 = var_of[(min(y,z),max(y,z))]
            e4 = var_of[(min(z,w),max(z,w))]
            solver.add_clause([-e1,-e2,-e3,-e4])
    # 5-cycles
    for quint in combinations(range(n),5):
        from itertools import permutations
        seen = set()
        for perm in permutations(quint):
            # cycle perm[0]..perm[4]..perm[0]
            # canonical
            a = min(range(5), key=lambda i: perm[i])
            rot = perm[a:]+perm[:a]
            if rot[1] > rot[-1]:
                rot = (rot[0],) + rot[:0:-1]
            if rot in seen: continue
            seen.add(rot)
            edges_in_cycle = []
            for i in range(5):
                u,v = rot[i], rot[(i+1)%5]
                edges_in_cycle.append(var_of[(min(u,v),max(u,v))])
            solver.add_clause([-e for e in edges_in_cycle])
    # At least num_edges edges
    lits = list(var_of.values())
    cnf = CardEnc.atleast(lits=lits, bound=num_edges, top_id=len(pairs), encoding=EncType.seqcounter)
    for cl in cnf.clauses:
        solver.add_clause(cl)
    return solver

        added = greedy_extend(adj, edges, pairs)
        edges.extend(added)
        if len(added) < len(removed):
            # revert probably worse, but keep trying
            pass
    if len(edges) > best:
        best = len(edges)
        best_edges = list(edges)
        print(trial, best, f"t={time.time()-start:.1f}")
        if best >= 28:
            break
print("final best:", best)
if best_edges:
    print(best_edges)
